# Doping (doping.games)

> Iranian gaming network: a dedicated low-ping tunnel (MikroTik RouterOS v7 + WireGuard) from Iran to exit nodes in Oman, the UAE and Europe, an anti-sanction gaming DNS with IP whitelisting, and Doping-hosted CS2 servers inside Iran.

- Plans: traffic-based or unlimited ping reduction, anti-sanction DNS by number of IPs, and a Pro bundle.
- Site language: Persian (fa-IR, right-to-left).
